correctness.rationale: The RESULT.md normalization 2F(2s)-1=tanh(s) and row sums 1 give a,b scalar flows s′=-(s-tanh s) and relay u′=-u+tanh(pa-(1-p)b). For s>0, g(s)>0, g(s)=s^3/3+O(s^5), so s~sqrt(3/2)t^-1/2 and t^3/2 g(s)~sqrt(3/2)/2. Uniqueness of autonomous flow gives exact signed shift tau=int_b0^a0 ds/g(s), and a(t)-b(t)=int_(t-tau)^t g(b(s))ds~sqrt(3/2)tau/(2t^3/2). Exponential convolution preserves the leading forcing coefficients, proving off-balance t^-1/2 and exactly balanced t^-3/2, with a0=b0 identically zero forcing and relay u(t)=u0 e^-t. For p_T=1/2+lambda/T, frozen terminal flows give T^3/2 u(T) -> sqrt(3/2)(tau/4+2lambda). Our separate solve_ivp/quadrature gave balanced 1.291757 at T=1300 vs 1.291849 target and crossover 4.96647 vs 4.96608. Finite checks are corroboration only; no uniform-in-lambda or general network claim.
